model_name: Direct Supervised Lung Cancer Diagnosis Model Target

validation_dataset_profile.name: Rejected Target Profile
validation_dataset_profile.outcome_variable: CNCRTYP1 == 19 (Historical lung cancer diagnosis among surviving respondents)

bangladesh_generalizability.evidence_gap_summary: Direct supervised diagnosis from self-reported health survey data is methodologically invalid and prohibited across all jurisdictions.
bangladesh_generalizability.prospective_requirements: Real-world clinical oncologic diagnosis requires tissue biopsy and histological grading, never retrospective questionnaire inference.

conditions_or_restrictions: Permanently prohibited. Any attempt to implement or deploy automated direct lung cancer diagnosis violates clinical safety invariants.
cab_review_decision.clinical_rationale: Direct supervised lung cancer diagnosis without histological confirmation is methodologically invalid. In BRFSS, living respondents reporting prior lung cancer represent an extreme survivor cohort (<0.10%), not active undiagnosed malignancy. Machine learning models trained on such targets learn outpatient survivorship correlates rather than oncologic etiology.

operational_activation.activation_blocked_reason: Methodological violation: Direct supervised lung cancer prediction without active incidence biopsy confirmation is prohibited.
